integrity: All cell counts, signed boundaries, determinant and modular-rank certificates, integral two-cycles, automorphism-group reduction, and the actions of all 120 elements of S_5 are regenerated by the supplied verifier using exact arithmetic.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns exactly two unordered particles on the Petersen graph. It does not claim a configuration-space cohomology ring, fundamental-group presentation, integral S_5-lattice classification, or any result for more particles.
title: Two-particle Petersen configuration homology as an \(S_5\)-module
